title: Application Deployment and DevOps
description: Deploy Azure applications using deployment slots, blue/green, canary, Azure DevOps, and GitHub Actions.
longDescription: This module teaches deployment strategies and DevOps practices for Azure applications. You will learn how to use deployment slots, implement blue/green and canary releases, build CI/CD pipelines with Azure DevOps and GitHub Actions, and manage secrets and environment configuration across stages.
whatYouLearn: Use deployment slots for zero-d downtime releases
Build CI/CD pipelines with Azure DevOps
Validate releases and roll back failed deployments
